name: Asafoetida
storage: Keep the lid tightly closed, and store it inside a second airtight jar so the smell does not spread to other foods. Room temperature, dry. It lasts about 1 year open.
looksLike: a fine, pale yellow to off-white powder with a very strong, sulphur-like smell, sold in small plastic or metal boxes. Everyday "compounded" hing is the resin mixed with wheat or rice flour and gum arabic.
howToPick: the box should be tightly sealed, and the powder should smell strong and pungent the moment it is opened. Avoid packs that smell weak or have hardened into lumps. Compounded hing is often not gluten-free because of the wheat flour.
shelfLife: about 12–24 months unopened (check the pack). The strength fades slowly after opening.
